description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'SendingContext' which encapsulates context information needed for publishing a message to a generic target within a messaging system. It includes details such as outbound signals, messages, targets, and monitoring components, and provides a builder for constructing instances.

classes.name: SendingContext
classes.description: An immutable context object containing details required for sending messages, including the message, target, and monitoring components.

classes.name: SendingContext.Builder
classes.description: A mutable builder class used for constructing instances of SendingContext with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Builder to construct a SendingContext.

methods.name: getMappedOutboundSignal
methods.description: Returns the mapped outbound signal associated with this context.

methods.name: getExternalMessage
methods.description: Returns the external message associated with this context.

methods.name: getGenericTarget
methods.description: Returns the target to which the message will be sent.

methods.name: getPublishedMonitor
methods.description: Returns the monitor tracking message publishing.

methods.name: getAcknowledgedMonitor
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the acknowledgment monitor if present.

methods.name: getDroppedMonitor
methods.description: Returns the monitor tracking dropped messages.

methods.name: getAutoAckTarget
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the auto-ack Target if present.

methods.name: shouldAcknowledge
methods.description: Determines whether the message should be acknowledged based on the presence of auto-ack target and acknowledgment monitor.

methods.name: setExternalMessage
methods.description: Returns a new SendingContext with the specified external message.
